Thanks, Jonas — heads up: Lee and I reviewed the draft and have a few redlines and a slightly different preferred quote. Inline below.

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — attaching the first draft of the customer story and the quote we'd like to pull into marketing. Short asks below so we don't lose momentum:
>
> 1) Quick fact-check (red bolded items in the doc): please confirm the 3.4x latency reduction and the line about 48% token-cost savings represent the production averages across your fleet.
> 2) Quote approval — there is a short customer quote near the top. If you prefer alternate wording I can swap it in.
> 3) Permissions — can we use the Sparq Energy logo and the quote on the website and a short one-page case study PDF?
> 4) Timeline — if we get sign-off this week, marketing will schedule the copy and visual review and publish in ~2 weeks.

Thanks for the diligence. Our requested edits: 
- Latency: the 3.4x number is correct for the 90th percentile on our pilot clusters, but please change wording from "across your fleet" to "on pilot clusters (90th pct)" — we can't claim fleet-wide until rollout is complete.
- Cost savings: change 48% -> 42% and add parenthetical "based on October 2026 billing sample (pilot clusters)".
- Remove the line that mentions our on-prem environment specifics — legal won't allow infrastructure detail.
- Please remove individual engineer names from the callout box (we prefer collective attribution to the "Sparq Energy Platform Team").

Preferred quote (you can paste exactly):
"Redwood's inference platform reduced our 90th-percentile latency by 3.4x on pilot clusters and helped us cut inference token costs by ~42% — enabling faster product iteration without compromising accuracy."

We are happy to grant logo and customer use permission once the edits above are applied and Sparq legal signs off.

Alex Murray
Head of Product — Sparq Energy
alex.murray@sparqenergy.com
